name: IntuiSim Modular 3D Asset Library
description: Foundational modular 3D WebGL assets for educational video pipelines and interactive SaaS simulation engine.

assets.name: Silicon Atom (Z=14)
assets.description: Isolated Silicon atom featuring a glowing +14q core, neon core [1s² 2s² 2p⁶], reactive M-shell [3s² 3p²], 3s radial nodal spheres (n - l - 1 = 2), and axial disassembly rails.

radius.description: Base visual scale radius of the atomic nucleus.

coreRadius.description: Bounding radius for the neon-like core [1s² 2s² 2p⁶].

valenceRadius.description: Radius for the valence shell holding 4 reactive electrons.

showRadialNodes.description: Controls visibility of concentric 3s radial zero-probability shells.

laserPlaneActive.description: Activates the horizontal laser slice plane exposing internal electron density.

materialStyle.description: Shading style adhering to Apple Keynote / linear luxury physical materials.

saasApiSchema.graphqlQuery: query GetSiliconAtom($disassembly: Float, $laserY: Float) { siliconAtom(disassemblyRail: $disassembly, laserPlaneY: $laserY) { id worldMatrix annotations } }

assets.name: sp³ Hybrid Orbital & Basis Group
assets.description: Parametric solid lathe hybrid orbitals representing the transformation from unhybridized basis {|3s⟩, |3px⟩, |3py⟩, |3pz⟩} to four 109.47° tetrahedral lobes and LCAO σ-bonding.

lobeLength.description: Maximum reach of the major positive hybrid lobe.

hybridization.description: Interpolation factor: 0.0 = pure unhybridized basis, 1.0 = pure sp³ hybrid.

caliperActive.description: Activates the 3D laser caliper dimension arc measuring 109.47°.

lcaoDistance.description: Inter-atomic approach distance: 5.0 = isolated, 2.35 = bonded silicon σ state.

saasApiSchema.graphqlQuery: query GetSp3Orbital($factor: Float, $caliper: Boolean) { sp3Orbital(hybridization: $factor, caliperActive: $caliper) { id angle annotations } }

assets.name: Keithley 6487 Digital Picoammeter
assets.description: High-precision benchtop digital picoammeter with live glowing VFD/LED 7-segment readout, gold-plated triaxial jacks, and flexible test leads.

initialCurrent.description: Initial live current readout in Amperes.

showProbes.description: Renders flexible high/low coaxial test leads curving toward contacts.

materials: CanvasTexture(VFD 7-segment digital font with #00ffcc phosphor glow)

saasApiSchema.graphqlQuery: query GetPicoammeter($amps: Float) { picoammeter(currentAmps: $amps) { id readout overload terminalPositions } }

assets.name: Diamond Cubic Crystal Unit Cell
assets.description: Diamond cubic unit cell (a = 5.43 Å) with 8 corner octants, 6 face-center hemispheres, 4 interior basis atoms, and crystallographic disassembly rails.

a.description: Lattice constant in Ångströms / visual units.

clippedOctants.description: Slices corner atoms into 1/8 wedges and face atoms into 1/2 hemispheres.

saasApiSchema.graphqlQuery: query GetUnitCell($explosion: Float, $clipped: Boolean) { unitCell(explosionFactor: $explosion, clippedOctants: $clipped) { id stoichiometry APF } }

assets.name: Kronig-Penney 3D Potential Well Terrain
assets.description: Deformable 3D potential energy heightfield V(x,z) with Coulomb lattice wells, periodic barriers, thermal acoustic phonons (0 to 300 K), and Bloch wavepacket transport.

initialTemperature.description: Lattice temperature in Kelvin controlling acoustic phonon amplitudes.

saasApiSchema.graphqlQuery: query GetPotentialTerrain($tempK: Float, $wavepacketX: Float, $wavepacketZ: Float) { potentialTerrain(temperature: $tempK, x: $wavepacketX, z: $wavepacketZ) { id surfaceElevation wavepacketStatus } }
